versions.changelog:
- Migrated to Filtrix Remote MCP; now uses a unified endpoint for all image generation and editing.
- Added support for gpt-image-1, nano-banana, and nano-banana-2 modes via MCP.
- Removed support and documentation for direct OpenAI, Gemini, and fal.ai integration.
- Introduced new references for MCP tools and available image generation modes.
- Added clearer setup, idempotency key usage, and recommended workflow guidance.
